# Configuration reference

Settings are environment variables. The API reads `apps/api/.env` (or the host's variables); the web app reads `apps/web/.env`. Copy `apps/api/.env.example` and `apps/web/.env.example` to start. A setting with no default is **required**.

## API (`apps/api`)

| Variable | Type | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `APP_NAME` | `str` | **required** | The product name, shown in logs and the API docs. |
| `APP_ENV` | `str` | **required** | `development`, `test` or `production`. Production switches logs to JSON. |
| `DATABASE_URL` | `str` | **required** | Postgres connection string (the Supabase session pooler), with the `postgresql+psycopg://` prefix. |
| `SUPABASE_URL` | `str` | **required** | Your Supabase project address; used to check sign-in tokens. |
| `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` | `str` | **required** | The Supabase **secret** key (not the public one). Never expose it to the browser. |
| `OPENAI_API_KEY` | `str` | `""` | OpenAI key. Leave empty to skip this provider. |
| `GEMINI_API_KEY` | `str` | `""` | Google Gemini key. Leave empty to skip this provider. |
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | `str` | `""` | Anthropic key. Leave empty to skip this provider. |
| `OPENAI_MODEL` | `str` | `"gpt-4.1-mini"` | Which OpenAI model to use. |
| `GEMINI_MODEL` | `str` | `"gemini-2.5-flash"` | Which Gemini model to use. |
| `ANTHROPIC_MODEL` | `str` | `"claude-haiku-5-5"` | Which Anthropic model to use. |
| `AI_PROVIDERS` | `str` | `"openai,gemini,anthropic"` | Providers to try, in order, comma separated. If one fails the next answers. A provider with no key is skipped. |
| `AI_REQUEST_TIMEOUT` | `float` | `60.0` | Seconds to wait for one provider before moving on to the next. |
| `AI_DAILY_TOKENS_PER_USER` | `int` | `0` | Most tokens (input plus output) one learner may use in a day across every AI feature; `0` means no limit. A safety net against one account running up the bill. |
| `AI_PRICES` | `str` | `""` | JSON `{"model": [usd_per_million_input, usd_per_million_output]}` to add or correct the price estimates in the admin cost view (see `app/ai/pricing.py`). |
| `GITHUB_TOKEN` | `str` | `""` | Optional GitHub token; raises the GitHub rate limit when the mentor reviews a repository. |
| `SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET` | `str` | **required** | The project's JWT secret from the Supabase settings. |
| `ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES` | `int` | `60` | Legacy setting kept for compatibility; Supabase decides how long a sign-in lasts. |
| `REDIS_URL` | `str` | `""` | Not used yet (rate limits use `RATE_LIMIT_STORAGE_URI`); kept so older `.env` files still load. |
| `VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY` | `str` | `""` | Web push public key. Push notifications are off when this and the private key are empty. Make a pair with `python scripts/generate_vapid_keys.py`. |
| `VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY` | `str` | `""` | Web push private key. |
| `VAPID_SUBJECT` | `str` | `"mailto:admin@example.com"` | A `mailto:` address that identifies you to browser push services. |
| `RESEND_API_KEY` | `str` | `""` | Resend key for sending email. With no key no email is sent (in-app and push notifications still work). |
| `EMAIL_FROM` | `str` | `"Uraan AI <onboarding@resend.dev>"` | The sender shown on emails, for example `Uraan AI <noreply@yourdomain.com>`. The domain must be verified in Resend. |
| `EMAIL_OUTBOX_DIR` | `str` | `""` | Development only: write each email to a file in this folder instead of sending it. |
| `WEB_URL` | `str` | `"http://localhost:3000"` | The web app's public address, used for links in emails (open the app, unsubscribe). |
| `API_PUBLIC_URL` | `str` | `"http://localhost:8000"` | This API's public address, used for links in emails. |
| `LOG_FORMAT` | `str` | `""` | `json` (default in production) or `text` for reading in a terminal. |
| `SQL_ECHO` | `bool` | `False` | Print every database statement. For debugging only. |
| `SLOW_REQUEST_MS` | `int` | `1000` | A request slower than this many milliseconds is logged as a warning. |
| `AUTH_CACHE_SECONDS` | `int` | `60` | How long a verified sign-in token is trusted without asking Supabase again; a sign-out is noticed within this time. `0` asks every time. |
| `LINK_CHECK_ENABLED` | `bool` | `True` | After a roadmap is built, check its resource links and remove dead ones. Needs outbound web access. The tests turn it off. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED` | `bool` | `True` | Master switch for rate limiting. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_STORAGE_URI` | `str` | `"memory://"` | Where request counters live: `memory://` (one API process) or `redis://...` (shared by several). |
| `RATE_LIMIT_ANONYMOUS` | `str` | `"50/hour"` | Requests per address for visitors who are not signed in (`count/hour` or `count/day`). |
| `RATE_LIMIT_AUTHENTICATED` | `str` | `"500/hour"` | Requests per signed-in learner. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_ADDRESS` | `str` | `"3000/hour"` | A ceiling per network address, so inventing accounts does not get around the limits. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_AI_CHAT` | `str` | `"100/day"` | Mentor messages per learner. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_ROADMAP_GENERATION` | `str` | `"10/day"` | Roadmap builds, rebuilds and updates per learner. |
| `SENTRY_DSN` | `str` | `""` | Sentry address for error reports. Off when empty. Reports carry no names, emails or text. |
| `SENTRY_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE` | `float` | `0.1` | Share of requests (0 to 1) that Sentry also records timing for. |
| `POSTHOG_API_KEY` | `str` | `""` | PostHog key for product statistics. Off when empty. Events carry a profile id only. |
| `POSTHOG_HOST` | `str` | `"https://eu.i.posthog.com"` | PostHog server address. |
| `ADMIN_EMAILS` | `str` | `""` | Comma separated emails that become admins the first time they sign in. Admins can promote others in the portal. |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | `str` | the local web address and the project's own sites | Websites allowed to call the API from a browser, comma separated, no trailing slash (for example your Vercel address). |

Which settings turn on optional features:

- AI: at least one of `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `GEMINI_API_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` (providers are tried in the order of `AI_PROVIDERS`).
- Email: `RESEND_API_KEY` and `EMAIL_FROM`. Without a key no email is sent (`EMAIL_OUTBOX_DIR` writes emails to files for development).
- Browser push: `VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY` and `VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY` (make them with `python scripts/generate_vapid_keys.py`).
- Monitoring: `SENTRY_DSN`, `POSTHOG_API_KEY` (each does nothing until set).
- Admin portal: `ADMIN_EMAILS`.

## Web app (`apps/web`)

Variables starting `NEXT_PUBLIC_` are visible in the browser and are fixed when the app is built: change one, rebuild.

| Variable | What it does |
|---|---|
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` | Your Supabase project address (used only for sign-in). |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` | The Supabase public (anon / publishable) key. Row Level Security keeps it from reading any data. |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL` | Where the browser reaches the API (no trailing slash, no `/api/v1`). |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL` | The address shown on the Contact page and in the Terms and Privacy Policy, and where data requests go. |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL` | The site's public address, for the sitemap and share previews. (optional) |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN` | Sentry address for browser error reports. Off when empty. (optional) |
| `SENTRY_DSN` | Sentry address for server-side error reports of the web app. Off when empty. (optional) |
| `INTERNAL_API_URL` | A private address for the web server to reach the API (for example `http://api:8000` between containers). Server-side only. (optional) |
| `NEXT_DIST_DIR` | Build into another folder (for example `.next-test`) so a test build never overwrites the files `npm run dev` is using. (optional) |
| `NEXT_OUTPUT` | Set to `standalone` by the Docker image to make a self-contained build. |
